kind: Fixed local renderer engineering comparison, not a human/game benchmark or novelty study
controls: Manual Canvas / Phaser WebGL / Empty rAF previews

fixture.scene: Same decoded painted street and seven72x96 sprite atlas frames
fixture.motion: Identical elapsed-time rectangular paths and depth order; manual clicks disabled during automatic cases
fixture.effects: No masks, labels, shadows, filters, physics, game-state/API operations or gameplay changes

stop_rules: WebGL unavailability/context loss/error explicitly invalidates case; no Canvas fallback masquerades as WebGL
Actual Phaser backing mismatch invalidates case
timing_exclusions: Engine boot/texture upload before fixed warmup

metrics.raw_interval: performance.now at rAF entry or Phaser PRE_STEP, not Phaser smoothed/capped delta
metrics.render_submit_cpu: Canvas draw submission span; Phaser PRE_RENDER→POST_RENDER, excluding renderer initialization/clear; neither measures GPU completion
metrics.whole_step_cpu: Canvas handler update/draw wall time; Phaser PRE_STEP→POST_RENDER wall time; includes more engine bookkeeping than render-only span
metrics.update_cpu: Shared fixture position update and renderer object position/depth assignment
metrics.cadence: 1000/mean actual observed frame interval, not hardware refresh-rate proof
metrics.60hz_unfilled_slots: sum(max(0,round(interval/(1000/60))-1)); estimates reference slots, not actual hardware dropped frames
metrics.memory: Browser JS-heap API snapshot if available, not process/GPU memory; null if unsupported

validity_limits: Single browser/apparatus and minimal fixed scene
Three ordered runs per mode; intervals within a run are dependent; no frame-level inferential confidence interval
Not a full-scene framework migration or proof of game responsiveness
No actual browser performance claimed until root runs and preserves exported JSON
Physical-device performance, GPU completion and hardware drops unmeasured
Phaser4.0 API documentation supports hooks used by vendored4.2.1; actual runtime availability/version is recorded
root_browser_recipe: Set desktop viewport before Run and keep stable/visible. Read #summary for compact status. Preserve #report.textContent through DOM-backed CUA read and local file write, or use Export JSON. Take an actual screenshot. Do not call these source checks performance results.
